entities.name: Photosystem II D1 (PsbA)
observations: 356-aa sequence matches reviewed cyanobacterial PsbA/D1 references at 73.9–76.8% identity and 98–100% query coverage; strongest match Q2JPR2 is 76.5% identical at 98.0% coverage.
Contains Pfam Photo_RC (PF00124.25) at residues 31–321; sequence-derived mass 38.50 kDa and pI 6.08.

Likely thylakoid multi-pass reaction-center subunit of Photosystem II; D1 participates in water-to-plastoquinone electron transfer and provides key ligands for the oxygen-evolving Mn4-Ca cluster. Function is inferred from close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: Photosystem II
observations: Light-driven water:plastoquinone oxidoreductase complex; D1/PsbA is a core reaction-center subunit.
